newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers steady amid quiet US/Iraq front.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers steady amid quiet US/Iraq front.

text.p: Singapore bunkers on Monday were little changed from Friday in a quiet market, as tensions in the Gulf appeared to have eased for now, traders said.
Indications for 180-cst bunker fuel were at $123-$125 per tonne and 380-cst at $117-$118.
Some majors were heard quoting at $119-$120 per tonne for 380-cst supplies, a shipowner said.
MDO was also stable at $209-$210 and gas oil at around $230. --Singapore Newsroom (+65-8703082)
